name: Death of a Party
source:
Illinois, 2006.

As eighteen-year-old Otto "Otter" White, you throw one final birthday party to celebrate high school graduation with your closest friends.

When they reveal they're leaving town, your fear of abandonment turns the night into a psychological nightmare.
